Read each file before editing it.

## Code fixes

### MessagePipeline (Source/Communication.Shared/Messages/MessagePipeline.cs)
1. Serialize exception must fault flushes: in WriteCoalescedBatchAsync, wrap the dequeue+serialize region so that if converter.Serialize throws, Flush of every item already dequeued into _batch (including the one being serialized) is faulted with that exception before rethrow. Same in SendLoopMessageAsync: on serialize exception fault that item's Flush, then rethrow into the Error-disconnect path.
2. Dispose/enqueue race: in EnqueueAsync, after _sendQueue.Enqueue + gate signal, re-check _stopped; if stopped, fault the local flush TCS (TrySetException is idempotent with Dispose's drain).
3. Send-side frame validation: after Serialize in the byte path, validate 0 < payloadLength <= LengthPrefixFramer.MaxFrameLength and throw ArgumentException on violation (empty payload would be indistinguishable from EOF on the peer). In the message path reject empty payloads too (no length cap there).
4. Stop pipeline on any disconnect: RequestDisconnect must also set _stopped=1 and cancel _cts after notifying, so a standalone pipeline faults further sends. Order carefully: the first notification must not be suppressed by the _stopped check in the loop catch clauses (notify when _notifiedDisconnect flips 0→1, then stop).
5. Start() idempotence: Interlocked guard; second Start() throws InvalidOperationException.
6. Batch semaphore releases: after a successful coalesced write call _sendSlots.Release(_batch.Count) once instead of per item (keep per-item Flush completion). In DispatchLoop count dequeued items and Release(count) once per drain.
7. Dispose hygiene: dispose _sendSlots and _receiveSlots in Dispose (loops already catch ObjectDisposedException).

### Receive path rewrite: sliding accumulation buffer
8. Rewrite LengthPrefixFrameReader (Source/Communication.Shared/Framing/LengthPrefixFrameReader.cs) as a buffered reader owning one ArrayPool accumulation buffer (~64KB default):
   - API: ValueTask<ReadOnlyMemory<byte>> ReadFrameAsync(CancellationToken) returning a payload slice backed by the internal buffer (valid until the next call). Empty memory = clean EOF. Dispose() returns the buffer.
   - Semantics: channel read 0 with zero accumulated bytes = clean EOF; channel read 0 with partial data = EndOfStreamException; frame length 0 = InvalidDataException; negative or length > MaxFrameLength = InvalidDataException.
   - Frames larger than free space: compact, grow buffer via ArrayPool (doubling) to fit header+body; frame fully inside buffer = zero-copy slice.
   - Keep LengthPrefixFramer.WriteFrame as the format anchor (tests use it); the pipeline wire writer keeps its inline reserve+patch path with the new validation from item 3.
   - Update the pipeline receive loop to ReadFrameAsync: empty → Remote disconnect; exception → Error disconnect; else Deserialize(frame.Span) → dispatch. No per-frame rent left in the loop.
9. PooledBufferWriter: in Clear(), if buffer length > 256KB return it and rent a fresh default-size buffer; short comment explaining the ceiling.

### Session / Listener / Options
10. Session.MarkDisconnected (Source/Communication.Shared/Sessions/Session.cs): invoke Disconnected subscribers individually — capture delegate once, iterate GetInvocationList(), each in try/catch with System.Diagnostics.Trace.TraceError; a throwing subscriber must not skip others or escape.
11. TcpListener (Source/Communication.Network.TCP/TcpListener.cs): if Accepted has no subscribers, dispose the accepted channel instead of leaking it.
12. SendOptions.Default (Source/Communication.Shared/Channels/SendOptions.cs): delete the property (no callers).
13. MessageQueueOptions.CoalesceLimitBytes XML doc: state the batch may overshoot the limit by up to one frame.

### Tests (Test/Communication.Tests)
14. Add FakeMessageChannel : IMessageChannel to TestDoubles.cs (records sent payloads+options, lets the test fire MessageReceived, can be set to fail SendAsync).
15. New tests: message-channel send/flush round-trip + SendOptions pass-through; message-channel send failure → Error disconnect; message-channel receive dispatch with InlineDispatch false and true; throwing converter → SendAndFlushAsync faults AND pipeline raises Error disconnect; dispose while a write is gated → pending flush faults (reuse FakeByteChannel.BlockWrites); receive zero-length frame (feed 00 00 00 00) → Error disconnect; TcpConnector cancellation → OperationCanceledException; SendAndFlushAsync honors ct; throwing Disconnected subscriber does not block the second subscriber; Start() twice throws. Update existing framing tests to the new reader API (empty = EOF; zero-length frame = InvalidDataException).
16. Keep tests deterministic (gates, not sleeps). Validation: dotnet build Communication.sln → 0 errors; dotnet test Test/Communication.Tests → all green; then run Sandbox chat end-to-end once: build, start server dll in background on a free port, pipe two lines + exit into the client dll, confirm server log shows the messages and 'client left (Remote)', client log shows 'disconnected: Local'; kill the server.

### Docs + project hygiene (same-turn vault rule)
17. Document/03-Reference/Configuration.md: add CoalesceLimitBytes row (기본 65536; 배치 상한 후 1프레임 초과 허용) and set frontmatter updated to 2026-08-31.
18. Document/02-Architecture/Pipeline.md and Session.md: frontmatter updated to 2026-08-31; Pipeline.md 수신 section: single accumulation buffer, zero-copy slice.
19. Document/01-Overview/Feature-Spec.md: reword F3-8 to: "Dispose 시 Cancel → 신호; 루프는 자체 스레드에서 Dispose가 호출될 수 있어 조인 없이 취소·채널 닫기로 탈출 보장 (레거시 '대기'는 앱 스레드 Dispose 전용이었음)". Update frontmatter updated date.
20. Communication.sln: Communication.Tests is nested under the Source solution folder — create a Test solution folder and move the project nesting there.
21. Sandbox/Chat.TCP/Program.cs: verify header usage comment matches actual arg handling; fix only if actually stale.

Implemented all 21 review fixes for DS_Communication (pipeline fault paths, buffered frame reader, session/listener hygiene, tests, docs, sln).

**Changed files:** `MessagePipeline.cs`, `LengthPrefixFrameReader.cs` (rewrite), `PooledBufferWriter.cs`, `Session.cs`, `MessageQueueOptions.cs`, `SendOptions.cs` (Shared); `TcpListener.cs` (TCP); 5 test files; `Program.cs` (Sandbox comment); `Communication.sln`; 6 vault docs.

**Surprise:** item 4's disconnect-time cancel exposed a race — the dispatch loop could exit on cancellation before delivering the last-enqueued message, violating "끊김 직전 메시지 전달" (flake on 1 of 2 initial runs).
